issues.extracted: General Fund department lines (general government/public safety)
issues.on_page: Department totals include General Fund capital outlay 34,943 (combining p7)
issues.issue: The budget schedule's department totals (general government 773,303, public safety 362,045) include 34,943 of capital outlay. The schedule does not print which department holds it, so it can't be split out. These lines are left in their functions, and the notes say so.

Federal is taken from the fund name. The line has review but no computed marker (the ARPA line detail[41] has computed). The 2026-11-12 FY2022 ruling keeps generic Intergovernmental as other state aid unless the page supports otherwise. The fund name 'U.S. Entitlement' is reasonable support.

Ending cash is a computed sum. The 2026-11-06 ruling says cash is never derived. The two printed lines are both cash, and the printed TOTAL ASSETS equals the sum, so this is acceptable, but a person should confirm it.
